requirements.description: User prefers properties near public transport. Value set to the 75th percentile of the mobility distribution (70.93, rounded to 71).

The user explicitly requires at least 180 sqm of gross floor area. The capacity of 14 people and the public transport preference are not gross-area requirements or reference columns, so they are not converted into filters. The city name 'Turin' is not mapped to comune_code, since no cadastral code was supplied.
